statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard electrocardiography.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
Prolonged cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is indicated to correlate symptoms with arrhythmic events and guide further management.
The service addresses diagnoses I48.0 and I47.1.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-97.
The denial reason is that the requested service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable under current policy guidelines.
